blocks.html: It’s the time of the year again for the people of Laoag to celebrate and showcase Ilocano tradition-Pamulinawen Festival a religious festival to commemorate St. William, the province’s patron saint. And spicing up the celebration Robinsons Malls’ Maja Salvador Mall show, on Saturday, February 08, at Robinsons Place Ilocos in San Nicolas, Ilocos Norte. Show starts 4 pm.

Don’t miss the opportunity to interact and strike a pose with Maja Salvador! Join the “Meet and Greet” activity which will be held after the show. The first 100 lucky fans who present a single receipt purchase worth P1000 cash or charge made on February 8, 2020 from any outlet at Robinsons Place Ilocos will be able to participate.

See the complete line-up of Robinsons Place Ilocos upcoming performances, events & promos in its Facebook page RobPlaceIlocos; or follow @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram; and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter.
